FILE_B=/srv/drop/.sticky-proof-bin
rm -f "$FILE_A" "$FILE_B"
su -s /bin/sh daemon -c 'umask 022; : > /srv/drop/.sticky-proof-daemon'
su -s /bin/sh bin -c 'umask 022; : > /srv/drop/.sticky-proof-bin'
stat -c 'created owner=%U group=%G mode=%a path=%n' "$FILE_A" "$FILE_B"
set +e
DENY_OUTPUT=$(su -s /bin/sh bin -c 'rm -f /srv/drop/.sticky-proof-daemon' 2>&1)
DENY_RC=$?
set -e
printf 'cross_user_remove_rc=%s\n' "$DENY_RC"
printf 'cross_user_remove_output=%s\n' "$DENY_OUTPUT"
[ "$DENY_RC" -ne 0 ]
[ -f "$FILE_A" ]
printf 'foreign_file_preserved=yes\n'
su -s /bin/sh daemon -c 'rm -f /srv/drop/.sticky-proof-daemon'
su -s /bin/sh bin -c 'rm -f /srv/drop/.sticky-proof-bin'
printf 'owner_cleanup_success=yes\n'
